query: Please implement a mobile data service application to provide mobile data services to global users. The application should have functionalities for managing data usage, transaction payments, and account balance inquiries. Users should be able to log in, browse their data usage, make transactions, and view their account balance. The application should also have problem diagnosis and troubleshooting functions to help users resolve issues during use. Define the background as ghost white and components as cadet blue.
